channel.title: Carat Capital — The Trade Paper of the Jewelry World
channel.description: Prices, intelligence and analysis from every desk of the stone trade: diamonds, gold and metals, gemstones, watches, auctions, retail and technology.

item.title: 8.63-carat pink leads Sotheby's Geneva with CHF 3.3m-5m estimate
item.description: JCK reports the unmounted fancy intense pink heads Sotheby's High Jewelry sale at the Mandarin Oriental on 11 November. A Graff ring with a 2.88-carat fancy deep blue carries an estimate of CHF 1.7 million to 2.5 million.

item.title: Agnico Eagle output falls 6.1% in Q3 as realised gold rises 22.7%
item.description: The miner expects 2026 payable output at the low end of its 3.3 million to 3.5 million ounce range. Canadian Malartic made 111,202 ounces in the third quarter, 29.1% below a year earlier, as lower-grade stockpiles supplemented mill feed.

item.title: Shanghai Gold Exchange volume up 7.6% on year to 5,064.6 tonnes
item.description: In its September market report, China's central bank puts Shanghai Futures Exchange gold volume down 12.8% on the year. It does not say whether the exchange tonnage counts one side of each trade or both.

item.title: Chrono24 watch price index closes Q3 at 1,471, up 0.7%
item.description: Haute Time, citing Chrono24's Q3 Quarterly Dial, puts the index 7.5% above a year earlier. Vacheron Constantin led with 17.7% over twelve months, Patek Philippe 17.0%, while Rolex slipped 0.2% in the quarter.

item.title: Il Ponte's jewellery sale totals over €3 million, 98% of lots sold
item.description: The Milan house's off-calendar Important Jewellery auction ran on 7 and 8 October. A Nardi coral necklace and a Cartier pearl-and-diamond choker each sold for €88,200, among the highlights it names.

item.title: Lab-grown producers' council threatens action over 'synthetic'
item.description: The Diamond Producers Council told jewelers on 20 October to reject CIBJO's September call for the word. It says its members grow more than 20 million carats a year.

item.title: IGI's lab-grown jewelry segment grows 47%, natural jewelry 3%
item.description: Revenue at the Mumbai-listed grader rose 31% to INR 3,980 million in the July to September quarter. Profit after tax rose 43% to INR 1,858 million on 4.35 million reports.

item.title: Audemars Piguet charges sellers up to 20% on its own resale site
item.description: The Watch Keepers, run by AP itself, listed 43 watches on 26 October. Buying and selling are open only to verified residents of the European Union and Switzerland.

item.title: Platinum Guild cuts four offices, including New York
item.description: PGI USA and PGI South Korea shut on 31 December and Japan on 30 December, JCK reports. Hong Kong ends in the same window, leaving China and India from 2027.

item.title: Newmont puts Red Chris block-cave capital at $4.2–4.8 billion
item.description: The estimate is net of a CAD$500 million Canadian grant whose terms are not final, and leaves out the cost of moving from open pit to block cave. Production is targeted for 2033.

item.title: India's US gem and jewellery exports near $3 billion, GJEPC says
item.description: Exports to the US rose nearly 6% in April to September from US$2.77 billion a year earlier, GJEPC's chairman said on 23 October. They had fallen more than 44% in April to December 2025.

item.title: Surat diamond unit shuts before Diwali with ₹10 lakh of pay owed
item.description: The owner of Marutinandan Diamonds in Varachha is untraceable, police said on 23 October. The union says he paid ₹4.50 lakh of ₹14.50 lakh in wages, then stopped answering.

item.title: Chow Sang Sang gold reads 1,200 yuan a gram, 14.8% below 25 August
item.description: Chow Tai Fook quoted 1,202 yuan and Lao Miao 1,196 on 24 October, after cuts of 6 to 12 yuan on the day. Shenzhen's Shuibei market drew weekend crowds, Qianjiang Evening News reports.

item.title: Luk Fook's self-run Mainland shops post +39% for 1–7 October
item.description: Hong Kong and Macao same-store sales rose 15% that week, and licensed Mainland shops were flat. Chow Tai Fook's filing shows Macao up 47.3% in July to September, against Hong Kong's 24.0%.

item.title: Zijin takes control of Chifeng Gold; third-quarter profit falls 41.84%
item.description: Zijin Gold and its concert parties now hold about 25.85% of the Chinese miner after a new H-share issue at HK$29.82, Chifeng said on 22 October. Nine-month net profit still rose 11.05%.

item.title: Lyon & Turnbull sells 98 of 113 London jewellery lots
item.description: Hammer prices totalled £323,620 by Carat Capital's count of the house's lot data. Three natural pearl lots made £61,000 against £21,000 in high estimates; the other 95 sold lots fell 8.6% short of theirs.

item.title: Petra Diamonds holders face a share suspension from 2 November
item.description: The London-listed miner says its FY2026 audit is unfinished, so it expects to miss the 31 October deadline for its annual report. It gives no date for trading to resume.

item.title: Newmont reports $1,454 an ounce all-in cost on $4,317 gold
item.description: Its third-quarter all-in sustaining cost fell from $1,621 in the second quarter but rose from $1,303 a year earlier. Newmont improved its full-year cost guidance to $1,520 an ounce.

item.title: Chow Tai Fook names gold-loan gains first in 90–100% profit alert
item.description: The jeweller expects half-year net profit to the end of September to rise by that much. Group retail value fell 0.5% in the July to September quarter, RTHK and on.cc report.

item.title: Zenith opens layoff talks at Le Locle; source says 100 of 196 jobs
item.description: The LVMH watch brand confirmed a mass-layoff consultation to the AWP news agency. An internal source quoted by AWP puts another 101 jobs at risk in its international distribution network.

item.title: Christie's puts HK$26.5m–43m on a Patek Sky Moon in Hong Kong
item.description: The Iconic 40 sale on 25 November marks Christie's 40th year in Asia. A ruby-dial F.P. Journe Tourbillon Souverain carries HK$16 million to HK$32 million, among five named lots.

item.title: De Beers pays 1bn pula into Botswana fund, JCK reports
item.description: The transfer is the initial payment under the 2023 deal, which Botswana said would total P10 billion over 10 years. JCK puts it at about $73 million.

item.title: GJEPC targets $50m in New Zealand as trade pact takes effect
item.description: India's gem and jewellery exports to New Zealand were $25.43 million in FY2025-26, the export council says. New Zealand's foreign ministry says the agreement entered into force on 20 October.

item.title: Paspaley sells through 14 US doors and caps new partners each year
item.description: The Australian pearl house told JCK it is deliberately not in 70 doors. It says it produces about 80% of Australia's South Sea pearls and has retailed its own jewellery for over 35 years.

item.title: Vietnam ends gold jewellery certificate, caps cash deals at VND 5m
item.description: Decree 390/2026 took effect on 16 October, cutting the non-cash line from VND 20 million a day. It also amends raw-gold import licence clauses and closes pending certificate files.

item.title: Sotheby's expects $9m-plus for 30 watches, nearly all first-owner
item.description: A platinum Patek 5374/300P-001 leads at $2.5 million to $5 million in New York on 7 December. Most of the rest are Tiffany-retailed Pateks, several double-signed and new to auction.

item.title: Phillips puts HK$6m–12m on Mark Cho's Journe Résonance
item.description: The Hong Kong sale on 21 and 22 November adds eight independent lots to a Patek group. An early Tourbillon Souverain carries a range of HK$3.9 million to HK$11.6 million.

item.title: Burgundy sets out breach remedies as ASX directs a November update
item.description: Its 9 October notice accepts that three 2025 rough pre-sales to a director's company needed shareholder approval first. ASX lists Burgundy as long suspended, with three periodic reports overdue.

item.title: De Beers' rough price index falls 20% as sales volume nearly doubles
item.description: Third-quarter output fell 11% to 6.8 million carats as Orapa and Venetia slowed. Rough sales rose 4% to $731m, and 2026 guidance rises to 25–28 million carats with all of Gahcho Kué.

item.title: Swiss watch exports rise 11.7%, a fourth straight monthly gain
item.description: September shipments reached CHF 2,225.9m, FH figures show. The US rose 85.7% and France 128.2%, gains FH ties to a base effect and possible trade reallocation, while China fell 14.2%.
